description.value: The Granville Room is a bar and casual dining venue on Vancouver's busy Granville Street entertainment corridor, serving cocktails, wine, flatbreads, burgers, tacos, and snacks in a cozy indoor setting. Originally known for its wine selection, it has since expanded to a full food menu with creative cocktails. It sits on one of the main urban cycling routes through downtown Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, active bar and casual dining venue at 957 Granville Street, Vancouver, consistent with the OSM amenity=bar tag and address. Vegetarian options are positively confirmed via explicit menu items including 'VEGGIE BURGER' and 'VEGGIE FAJITAS STYLE' on the food menu subpage. The /contact-us/ subpage has been hijacked by unrelated Indonesian gambling content (MEME4D), and the website header displays a clearly fake placeholder phone number (+1 123 456 7890), while a real booking number (+1 604-565-3005) appears in the happy hours page and footer.
concerns: The /contact-us/ subpage has been hijacked by unrelated Indonesian gambling/lottery content (MEME4D bandar togel online) — likely a website security compromise.
Website header displays a clearly fake/placeholder phone number (+1 123 456 7890); the real booking number appears to be +1 (604) 565-3005 as listed in the happy hours page and footer.
OSM opening hours (Tu-Th,Su 11:00-03:00, Fr,Sa 10:00-03:00) differ significantly from the website-stated hours — OSM hours appear outdated or incorrect.
Name inconsistency: OSM lists 'Granville Room' but the website uses 'The Granvilleroom' and 'The Gran Ville Room' interchangeably.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible bar and restaurant in downtown Vancouver with an active website and full menu.
